overview: Management starts with a clear picture. In this starter sprint we check your account health, review your listings and orders, update what is outdated and send you a plain report of the first round of work, with the next steps. You see what we do and what it changes before deciding on more. Monthly management after the sprint is quoted separately, based on your catalog and order volume.

faq: No. It is a fixed-price starter sprint that does the setup and the first round of work. Monthly care is quoted separately, once we know your catalog and how much attention it needs.
What permissions do you need in my account?
A user role with listing and report access, added by you in your seller account. We do not need payment or bank permissions, and we never ask for your password. You can remove access any time.
Do you reply to customers and reviews?
We check messages and prepare replies for you in the Standard and Premium packages. We reply to reviews only to answer genuine questions, and we never ask for, trade or pay for reviews.
What results should I expect from the sprint?

A cleaner account, fixed listings and a clear plan. We cannot promise sales growth because stock, price and competition play a part too. The report shows what we changed so you can judge for yourself.
